Q: How to perform a variable number of positional substitutions A:

This works as you required:

:%s/\(^.*\d\s\)\zs.\{-}\(\w\+\)\|\(\w\+\)/'&'/g

OUTPUT:

abc 1 'ab' 'abc' 'a' 'abc' 'def'
x 2 'fgh' 'fg' 'hg' 'gg' 'ddd'

Q: .NET 8 - SHA3 not supported on my platform A:

The PlatformNotSupportedException is because SHA3 in .NET (modern) is only available on platforms that have an OS implementation of it: currently only Windows 11 Build 25324+ and OpenSSL 1.1.1+ (Linux).

Per discussion on GitHub, this is because "[Microsoft] have a strict policy of only using cryptographic algorithms provided by underlying platforms … That ensures we don't have to worry about provable correctness or avoiding side channels" [Browser WASM is an exception to the rule, but doesn’t have an SHA3 implementation either.]

If you need SHA3 on other platforms including older versions of Windows, you’ll need to use third party libraries such as Bouncy Castle or SHA3.NET.

Q: Is it possible to install a package only in current project with PIP A:

In Python 3.9+, setting up a project is recommended.

Run these commands:

python -m venv myproject
myproject\Scripts\activate

Q: Host can't ping docker container on ipvlan l2 A:

The best way to work around this is by creating a second network, for example, bridge for host communication.

That way you can also make custom mapping of the ports on the bridge interface, while maintaining the other interface usable.

Q: How do I run an arm64-v8a architecture image on an enulator? A:

you could use waydroid, you will need a few things before using waydroid

  1. be in wayland or use a nested session inside of x11 the simplest example is cage. cage waydroid

  2. You need to run a kernel which comes with the binder modules. the zen kernel (called Liquorix in debian based distros) has the necessary modules

    curl -s 'https://liquorix.net/install-liquorix.sh' | sudo bash

Alternatively, you can recompile the linux kernel — or other kernel packages (>=5.7) — with the necessary options. then reboot into the kernel

then install it from the official script

curl https://repo.waydro.id | sudo bash

sudo apt install waydroid -y

sudo waydroid init -s GAPPS

this will let you install google play apps Next start/enable the waydroid-container.service.

Make sure that waydroid-container.service is started then run

Launch GUI

waydroid show-full-ui

to learn more about waydroid: consult the wiki
